name: Binary Greedy Voxel Meshing without Ambient Occlusion
definition: Generates mesh vertices for a face direction without ambient occlusion, iterating over block types and axes, using a fixed array for x_data.
summary: Binary Greedy Voxel Meshing without Ambient Occlusion generates mesh vertices for voxel faces by iterating block types and axes, outputting vertices with ao=0 and block_type=0.
